subject: math

objective.text: Seconds and minutes measure time. Time keeps going all the time, even when you stop measuring.

explanations.title: Seconds
explanations.text: A second is a very short time. Seconds are a unit of time. They are smaller than minutes.

explanations.title: Minutes
explanations.text: A minute is much longer than a second. There are 60 minutes in 1 hour.

source_ref.section: Concept Development, Part 2 and Fluency: Minute Counting

explanations.title: Time is continuous
explanations.text: Time never stops. It always moves forward. A stopwatch only measures a little part of it.

explanations.title: How a minute feels
explanations.text: A minute can feel fast or slow. But a minute is always the same amount of time.

examples.title: Tying 8 shoes
examples.text: 1 shoe takes 5 seconds. Count by fives 8 times: 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40. That is 40 seconds.

source_ref.section: Application Problem and Concept Development, Part 1

examples.title: Count by 5 minutes
examples.text: Start at 12 on the clock. Count 5, 10, 15, up to 60. 60 minutes is 1 hour.

source_ref.section: Fluency: Tell Time on the Clock

questions.text: Count by 5 minutes from 12 on the clock. How many minutes when you get back to 12?

source_ref.section: Fluency: Tell Time on the Clock

questions.text: How many minutes are in a half hour?
Count by sevens: 7, 14, 21. What number comes next?
Ms. Bower takes 5 seconds to tie 1 shoe. How many seconds does it take to tie 8 shoes?
Which unit is longer, a second or a minute?
We stopped the stopwatch. Did time stop? Explain.
Is a stopwatch a good tool to measure how long it takes to turn 10 years old? Why?
A minute of talking feels faster than a minute of waiting. Is it still 1 minute?
Jumping jack times: Maya 16, Riley 15, Jake 14, Nicholas 15, Adeline 17 seconds. Who was fastest?
Who took the exact same time: Maya 16, Riley 15, Jake 14, Nicholas 15, or Adeline 17 seconds?
Jake took 14 seconds. Adeline took 17 seconds. How many seconds faster was Jake?
Samantha ran 100 meters in 19 seconds. Louie took 24 seconds. How many seconds faster was Samantha?
Run times: Samantha 19, Melanie 22, Chester 26, Dominique 18, Louie 24 seconds. Who is the slowest?
Seconds and minutes both measure time. How are they different?
